harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired bin/unpack on node1. Normal nested archives extract transactionally into incoming/, while absolute paths, parent traversal, and symlink escapes are rejected without altering installed content. Source packages and protected data remain unchanged. The fix persisted across a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Replaced unchecked tar extraction with a Python 3.12-compatible validator and staged transactional extraction.
Preserved merge behavior by copying existing incoming/ content into staging before committing.
Rejected absolute paths, parent traversal, escaping links, and special-device members.
Verified normal.tar extraction and all supplied malformed archives before and after reboot.
Removed temporary rollback, test-output, bytecode, and staging artifacts.

evidence.summary: normal.tar produced incoming/docs/notice.txt containing “Supplier notice.” before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Absolute paths, parent traversal, and symlink escapes are rejected before installation
evidence.summary: All malformed packages returned rejection errors; incoming content remained unchanged and /outside.txt remained absent.

evidence.requirement: Source packages and protected files are preserved
evidence.summary: SHA-256 hashes for all four packages and protected/customer.txt remained identical throughout testing and restart.

evidence.requirement: Compatible repair installed without OS or kernel replacement
evidence.summary: Root-owned executable installed using existing Python 3.12; post-restart evidence confirms RHEL 10.0 and the original kernel release.

Healthy baseline boot ID e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 7b92e516-ee57-4066-905b-e4ec5a45722e, running system with no failed units, intact data, and repeated functional security tests.
